analysis: Revenue was $13K in 9M to Jul 2023, down 62% year over year.

Gross margin was 54.7%, down 45.3 points from 9M to Jul 2022. Operating costs exceeded revenue by $1.0M, an operating margin of -7400.2%. Operating expenses grew 17% against revenue growth of -62%. The fastest-growing cost line was Other operating costs (+17%). The period ended with a net loss of $1.0M.
Operating cash flow was −$898K. Non-cash charges added back $20K of depreciation and amortization and $2K of share-based compensation.
